general.name: General account
general.description: An ordinary brokerage account. Realized gains and dividends are taxed at {gainsRate}; losses offset gains and dividends and carry forward for {years} years if you file a tax return.

saver.name: Saver account
saver.description: A tax-free account for unleveraged equity funds, bought in one go or by a regular plan. You may buy up to {annual} a year; selling does not give that room back.

losses.filing: Losses offset other income and carry forward only if you file a tax return for the year.
